settings.title: Settings
settings.approvalChainsHint: Estimates at or above this amount need this many distinct internal approvals before they can be sent to the client. Leave blank to disable.
settings.brandingHint: Your logo and brand color appear on generated estimate and invoice PDFs.

settings.webhooksHint: Send a signed HTTP POST to your own URL when things happen — new integrations, Slack/Zapier, or your own backend.

settings.pushNotificationsHint: Get browser alerts for low stock, due reminders, and overdue invoices — even when Cantero isn't open.

settings.inviteEmailHint: An email with an accept link is sent to this address.
settings.slaEscalationHint: RFIs and punch list items left open past this many days are automatically flagged and emailed to the company owner. Leave blank to disable.
settings.emailDigestHint: Get an email summary of what's new (overdue RFIs, low stock, mentions, and more) instead of checking the notification bell.
settings.invoiceRemindersHint: Sends escalating reminder emails to the client at 3, 7, 14, and 30 days past the due date.
settings.customRolesHint: Combine permission tiers under one name — e.g. "Site Lead" = Foreman + Estimator — for a member who needs more than one fixed role. Purely additive: it never takes away what a member's own role already grants.
